title: Basic LED Circuit with Current Limiter
description: Construct a basic protected LED circuit across a 5V breadboard rail.

steps.title: Place Current-Limiting Resistor
steps.instruction: Insert a 330 ohm resistor into rows D10 and D14.

hints.missing: Place the 330 ohm resistor on the board.
hints.wrong_position: Move the resistor so its legs connect to rows D10 and D14.

steps.title: Place the LED
steps.instruction: Insert the LED: Anode (red tagged leg) in D14, Cathode in D18.

hints.missing: Insert the LED into holes D14 and D18.
hints.wrong_position: Check LED holes: long leg (anode) in D14, short leg in D18.
hints.reversed: Reverse the LED: the red-tagged anode must connect to the resistor at D14.

steps.title: Connect Power Rail
steps.instruction: Connect a red wire from the +rail (VCC) to row D10.

hints.missing: Connect a red wire from +rail to row D10.
hints.wrong_position: One end of the red wire must be in +rail, the other in D10.

steps.title: Connect Ground Return
steps.instruction: Connect a black wire from row D18 to the -rail (GND).

hints.missing: Connect a black wire from D18 to the ground rail (-rail).
hints.wrong_position: One end of the black wire must be in D18, the other in -rail.

steps.title: Verify Circuit Integrity
steps.instruction: Ensure hands are clear and press TEST to verify complete circuit before powering.

hints.missing: Ensure all components remain firmly seated in their holes.
